name: Honey Experience Festival with Beekeeping Workshop
beschreibung: At the Bienenerlebnisgarten Brixental, everything revolves around the honey bee. Visitors experience live beekeeping demonstrations, honey tastings from blossom to jar, and creative workshops for children. An educational day for the entire family celebrating the fascinating world of bees.
kurzbeschreibung: A festival for bee lovers featuring beekeeping demonstrations, honey tastings, and children's workshops.
